description: Cursor Automations + Grok Bot routines for Vesper (#1) and Grok Long Memory (#2)
notes: Create each Cursor Automation at https://cursor.com/automations using the matching prompt file.
Prefer model cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast (or latest Grok from GET /v1/models).
Grok Bot routines cannot read .cursor/hooks.json — paste from automations/grok_bot_routines/.
Project hooks apply to Cursor/Cloud Agents. Fan-out with: python3 -m leader_hq.cli notify-grok --all

automations.name: Nova morning shared-Grok poll (8am PT)
automations.suggested_trigger: cron 0 15 * * * (15:00 UTC ≈ 8am PT standard) or 0 16 * * * during PDT
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Processes from_vesper + from_grok_memory; fan-out status to both to_* lanes

automations.name: LeaderHQ bus sync on main/PR push
automations.suggested_trigger: GitHub: push to main OR pull_request synchronize
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Keeps Drive LeaderHQ + Grok Long Memory/from_nova aligned for both bots

automations.name: Shared Grok / NOVA webhook intake
automations.suggested_trigger: Webhook (POST from either Grok computer or Drive watcher)
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Immediate Nova response when Vesper or Grok Long Memory drops a request

grok_bot_routines.schedule: on demand / when Vesper needs code
